name: Kagome
source:
She is the head of a group of wandering performers called kugutsu, or "puppeteers," or "drifters," who are engaged in a mysterious occupation.

She is strong-willed, outspoken, and uninhibited, but she also has a sense of responsibility as the head of her family. She has a sense of responsibility as the head of her family and is ruthless toward those who do not respect others.

She is also deeply involved with a certain character in this work...
